contact.mapQuery: Tequila's Mexican Grill and Bar, 1860 Richland Ave W, Aiken, SC 29801

hero.eyebrow: Mexican grill & bar on Richland Avenue
hero.title: Fajitas, molcajetes and *fresh guacamole*
hero.lede: A fan favorite for authentic Mexican cooking in Aiken: sizzling fajitas, tacos on corn tortillas with cilantro and onion, seafood from the grill and a molcajete built for sharing.

sections.title: A taste of *the menu*
sections.intro: A few favorites from the full menu. Fajitas come with rice, beans, lettuce, tomatoes, sour cream, guacamole and grilled vegetables, with corn or flour tortillas.
sections.footnote: Prices from the restaurant's online ordering menu, November 2026. Call to confirm today's prices.

items.title: Dine in
items.text: A full Mexican grill and bar on Richland Avenue West.

items.title: Order ahead
items.text: Order online for pickup and skip the wait.

items.title: Vegetarian plates
items.text: Ten meat-free plates, from the vegetarian chimichanga to the chile poblano.

items.a: Yes. There are ten vegetarian plates, including a vegetarian chimichanga, a mushroom quesadilla, a spinach quesadilla and a chile poblano, plus vegetarian fajitas.
Yes. The full menu is available to order online for pickup.

items.q: Is there anything to share for a group?
items.a: The molcajete is made for sharing: carne asada, chicken, shrimp, chorizo, queso fresco and grilled cactus, with rice, beans, salad and tortillas. Fajitas Parrilla brings five meats to the table.

sections.title: Hungry, Aiken?
sections.text: Call ahead or come in at 1860 Richland Avenue West.
